Context: - Section 80-D

- Section 80-U  
Tax on Income.An option has been given to the assessee from the Assessment Year beginning from 1st April, 2021 to compute tax on income under Section 115-BAC, provided he does not avail any exemption or deductions under Chapter VI-A other than sub-section (2) of Section-80-CCD.  
- Section 115-BAC
